rs-pr-bear-sign.front: Fresh signs of recent bear activity?
rs-pr-bear-sign.back: Tracks, scat, overturned logs, dug up anthills.

rs-pr-cougar-days.front: How long does a cougar stay near a kill?
rs-pr-cougar-days.back: It feeds for about 6 to 8 days.

rs-pr-scratch.front: Long claw scrape marks over 61 cm on a kill?
rs-pr-scratch.back: Cougar. Bobcat marks are 41 cm or less.

rs-pr-drill.back: Stop, look and listen, read from afar, back out loud, tell and report (SLRBT).

rs-pr-rapp.front: BC number for wildlife danger to people?
rs-pr-rapp.back: RAPP (Report All Poachers and Polluters): 1 877 952 7277, 24 hours.

Call RAPP</text><text x="200" y="196" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="middle">1 877 952 7277</text><text x="200" y="260" font-size="14" fill="#6b4f35" text-anchor="middle">RAPP: Report All Poachers and Polluters</text>

rs-pr-risk.front: When are bear surprises most likely?
rs-pr-risk.back: Loud water, wind or rain, dawn, dusk, night, thick cover and bends.
rs-pr-risk.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 296" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Be extra cautious near loud water, in strong wind or rain, at dawn, dusk or night, and in thick cover or at bends where you could surprise a bear at close range.">
<rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="296" rx="0" fill="#fffaf0"/>
<text x="200" y="28" font-size="19" font-weight="bold" fill="#2f3a2b" text-anchor="middle">When surprise is likely</text>
<rect x="16" y="62" width="180" height="88" rx="10" fill="#f6e3d8"/><text x="106" y="100" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c62828" text-anchor="middle">Loud water</text><text x="106" y="126" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="middle">it cannot hear you</text><rect x="204" y="62" width="180" height="88" rx="10" fill="#f6e3d8"/><text x="294" y="100" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c62828" text-anchor="middle">Strong wind, rain</text><text x="294" y="126" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="middle">it cannot smell you</text><rect x="16" y="162" width="180" height="88" rx="10" fill="#f6e3d8"/><text x="106" y="200" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c62828" text-anchor="middle">Dawn, dusk, night</text><text x="106" y="226" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="middle">bears are active</text><rect x="204" y="162" width="180" height="88" rx="10" fill="#f6e3d8"/><text x="294" y="200" font-size="16" font-weight="bold" fill="#c62828" text-anchor="middle">Thick cover, bends</text><text x="294" y="226" font-size="14" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="middle">surprise at close range</text><text x="200" y="284" font-size="15" font-weight="bold" fill="#23261f" text-anchor="middle">Extra caution here (85%)</text>
</svg>

rs-pr-hunter-risk.front: Why are hunters at higher risk of bear encounters?
rs-pr-hunter-risk.back: Quiet, using calls and scents, often alone, handling carcasses.

rs-pr-gut.front: Leaving your carcass to return later?
rs-pr-gut.back: Move it at least 200 m from the gut pile. Bears go to the gut pile first.

</svg>

rs-pr-hang.front: Hang meat in bear country: numbers?
rs-pr-hang.back: At least 3.5 m up, 1.5 m from trees, in plain view, 100 m from camp.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 304" font-family="sans-serif" role="img" aria-label="Hanging meat in bear country: hang it at least 3.5 metres up and 1.5 metres from tree trunks, in plain view, at least 200 metres from the gut pile and 100 metres from camp.">

rs-pr-return.back: Approach from upwind, glass first, make lots of noise.

rs-pr-moved.front: Your carcass has been moved or buried?
rs-pr-moved.back: Do not approach. Leave immediately and report.

rs-pr-drag.front: Why not drag the carcass back to camp?
rs-pr-drag.back: It lays a scent trail a bear can follow to where you sleep.

rs-pr-watch.front: Who does what while field dressing in bear country?
rs-pr-watch.back: One works, one watches with spray and rifle. Make noise.
